longDescription: Search Recluse Studio’s published research and build reports on AI, knowledge management, music equipment, and creative work. Retrieve articles in numbered passages with original source links, author attribution, publication dates, and canonical URLs. Find recent posts and related articles through the publication’s curated topics. The connector provides public, read-only access and requires no login.
releaseNotes: Initial release with search, paginated article retrieval, recent posts, curated-topic relations, and original attribution.
demoVideoStatus: A 77-second walkthrough of the connected archive in ChatGPT is published and saved in the OpenAI review draft.
categoryStatus: Education & Research is an accepted OpenAI directory category.
